script.title: Voyager 1 Is About to Be One Light Day From Earth
sentences: On November 18, Voyager 1 reaches one light day from Earth.
In 2025, its signals already took over 23 hours to arrive.
NASA launched it on September 5, 1977, and the launch almost failed.
The rocket's second stage quit early, leaving 540 kilograms of fuel unburned.
The Centaur stage's computers caught it and burned far longer than planned.
In 1990 it photographed Earth as the Pale Blue Dot, then its cameras went dark.
At about 17 kilometres a second, nothing we've built is farther away.
Its plutonium may keep it talking until 2036, one day per message.
script.description:
On November 18, 2026, Voyager 1 reaches one light day from Earth.
Its 1977 launch nearly failed.
claims_en: Voyager 1 is projected to reach a distance of one light day from Earth on November 18, 2026
As of 2025, signals from Voyager 1 took more than 23 hours to reach Earth
Voyager 1 was launched by NASA on September 5, 1977
The Titan's LR-91 second stage shut down prematurely, leaving 540 kg (1,200 lb) of propellant unburned
The Centaur stage's on-board computers ordered a burn far longer than planned to compensate
On February 14, 1990, Voyager 1 took the family portrait including the image of Earth known as Pale Blue Dot
Soon afterward its cameras were deactivated
It is the most distant human-made object from Earth
Its RTGs are fuelled by plutonium-238 and may supply enough power to return engineering data until 2036
